parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Equate their completed-square form from 6(a) to 45, e.g. $4(x+\frac52)^2-19=45\Rightarrow(x+\frac52)^2=16$ — *M1; or restart and complete the square.
Solve as far as $x=$ — DM1; any valid method leading to two answers.
$x=3/2,-13/2$ — A1. SC: if M0 or M1 DM0, B1 for both correct final answers.
Total: 3
